It covers bumping the five movable parents, the api-extractor watch, and the exceljs chain and override-retarget measurement. `Fixes #35828` closes the only card that tracks this exemption, so after merge nothing would hold the work. File the follow-up card and put its `#N` in that bullet, with no closing keyword next to it. I will read only the body after that.

**What I checked, which carries to the ACCEPT:**

- **Shape:** `l1-face.mjs --pr 36155` CLEAN at 3620089773: open, draft, base main; first line `Fixes #35828`; one file, `osv-scanner.toml` (+2/−2); labels `osv-exemption` + `skip-changeset`, nothing published; `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`; no other change rides along (convention 3).
- **Convention 1:** `ignoreUntil = 2026-12-21` is a bare date exactly 30 days from 2026-11-21: the default, under the 90-day ceiling. **Convention 2:** the reason opens with the advisory URL and names what blocks the fix.
- **Reason sentence, checked against `pnpm-lock.yaml` at the head:**
  - minimatch copies: 10.2.6 and 11.0.3 only. The override is `'minimatch@<11.0.0': '^10.2.3'` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.
  - Snapshots on 10.2.6: `@eslint/config-array@0.23.5`, `@microsoft/api-extractor@7.58.2`, `@oclif/core@5.1.2`, `@ts-morph/common@0.29.0`, `@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree@8.72.1`, `eslint@10.13.0`, `glob@7.2.3`, `readdir-glob@1.1.3`. On 11.0.3: `glob@14.0.3`.
  - Every `glob@7.2.3` parent (archiver-utils 2.1.0 and 3.0.4, rimraf 2.7.1 via fstream 1.0.12 via unzipper 0.10.14), and `readdir-glob@1.1.3` via archiver 5.3.2, lead back to `exceljs@4.4.0` → archiver 5.3.2 / unzipper 0.10.14.
  - `typedoc@` has zero matches in the lockfile, so the deviation from the dispatch order is right.
- **npm registry, read today:**
  - api-extractor newest 7.60.1 has `minimatch: 10.2.3` exact.
  - exceljs newest 4.4.0 has archiver `^5.0.0`, unzipper `^0.10.11`.
  - Newest releases declaring 11: eslint 10.15.0 `^11.0.5`, @eslint/config-array 0.23.6 `^11.0.5`, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.73.0 `^11.0.1`, @oclif/core 5.1.12 `^11.0.1`, @ts-morph/common 0.29.1 `^11.0.1`.
  - The PR table matches line for line.
- **"Shipped reach", re-read for the renewal (convention 3):**
  - Published packages whose `dependencies` hold a minimatch holder: `@objectstack/cli` (@oclif/core), `@objectstack/rest`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-report` (exceljs), `@objectstack/metadata` and `@object-ui/cli` (glob 14 → 11.0.3). These are exactly the body's six.
  - In the `@oclif/core@5.1.2` tarball, minimatch is used only in `lib/config/plugin-loader.js`, matching dependency names against config wildcards.
  - In the `exceljs@4.4.0` tarball, `lib/` uses only `unzipper.Parse` and `Archiver('zip')`, with `append` / `file`. There is no `glob`, `directory` or `Extract` call, so the minimatch-bearing paths are not reached.
  - `packages/rest/src` imports neither glob nor minimatch.
  - The no-request-pattern conclusion holds.
- **Gates:** 24 success, 30 skip (expected), 0 failed, 0 pending at 3620089773. Validate Package Dependencies, the PR's OSV run, is success. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both success. The local OSV run marked NOT MEASURED is covered by that CI check.
